title: Exceptional Private Food & Wine Tour – David & Selu are Culinary Masters in Seville!
text:

title: Fabulous Food Tour

title: More like an evening out with a local friend than a tour
text:
We had such a great evening with David on this tapas tour. From the beginning, he made us feel very comfortable and the whole experience felt more like going out for tapas with a local friend than being on an organised tour.

David was warm, easy to talk to and clearly knows Sevilla very well. We went to places we probably would never have discovered on our own, tried different local tapas, and along the way learned a little more about the food, the traditions and life in Sevilla. Add a bit of history of Spain too. Nothing felt rushed or overly scripted, which we really appreciated.
